statement.zh: Tibo 承诺：接下来的 28 天，每天推出一项对多数 Codex / Work 用户有用的明显改进，或进行一次完整额度重置。
statement.en: Tibo’s pledge: over 28 days, ship a clear improvement useful to most Codex / Work users each day, or a full quota reset.

body.zh: Tibo 宣布优化 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的默认速度，覆盖订阅中的各产品及使用 ChatGPT 登录的合作伙伴产品。用户无需操作；原帖预计改进会在随后两小时内逐步生效。
body.en: Tibo announced faster defaults for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol across subscription products and partners using Sign in With ChatGPT. No user action is needed; the post expected rollout over the following two hours.

title.zh: Auto-review 免费且不占套餐用量
title.en: Auto-review is free with ChatGPT sign-in

body.zh: 通过 ChatGPT 账户登录的所有用户，现可免费使用 Auto-review，且该功能不消耗套餐用量。在输入框下方的权限菜单选择“Approve for me”，即可使用 Auto-review，为长任务中的操作增加复核。
body.en: Users who sign in with a ChatGPT account can use Auto-review without a charge against their subscription usage. Open the permissions menu below the composer and select “Approve for me” to review actions taken during longer tasks.

title.zh: API 用量等级简化为三档
title.en: API usage tiers simplified to three

body.zh: OpenAI API 的付费用量等级由五档简化为 Build、Launch、Grow 三档。最高档 Grow 的累计 API 付款门槛从 1,000 美元降至 500 美元，更容易获得更高请求速率限制。
body.en: OpenAI API paid usage tiers are simplified from five to three: Build, Launch, and Grow. The total API payment threshold for Grow, the highest tier, is reduced from $1,000 to $500, making it easier to qualify for higher rate limits.

title.zh: Meetings 自动整理会议笔记
title.en: Meetings takes notes and prepares follow-ups

body.zh: Meetings 插件可记录会议，并在 ChatGPT Space 保存个性化摘要和后续步骤，支持私下保留或与团队分享。现向 macOS 版 ChatGPT 的 Pro 和 Business 用户开放测试，Enterprise 支持尚未推出。
body.en: The Meetings plugin takes notes and saves personalized summaries and next steps in ChatGPT Space. Notes can stay private or be shared with your team. It is available in beta for Pro and Business users in the ChatGPT macOS app; Enterprise support is coming later.

body.zh: Decisions API 现向所有开发者开放公测，可帮助应用近乎实时选择模型、工具或操作。官方称，其决策速度最高可达通过 Responses API 使用 GPT-6 Luna 的 10 倍。Tibo 计划将其用于改善应用体验。
body.en: Decisions API is available to all developers in public beta for choosing models, tools, or actions in near real-time. OpenAI says it makes decisions up to 10 times faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API. Tibo plans to use it to improve the app experience.

title.zh: 第 2 天额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 宣布本次额度重置已处理完成，并确认此前发布的改进会保留。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo has confirmed that the reset has been processed and that the earlier improvements will remain available. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.en: New GPT-6 rolling out in ChatGPT

body.zh: Tibo 宣布向所有 ChatGPT 用户推出新版 GPT-6，包含模型和基础设施改进；第 3 天总结明确将 GPT-6 in Chat 列为当天主要改进。新版正在推出，不代表所有账户已同时收到。
body.en: Tibo announced a new version of GPT-6 for all ChatGPT users, with model and infrastructure improvements. His Day 3 roundup identifies GPT-6 in Chat as the day’s main improvement. Rollout is underway; this does not mean every account has received it simultaneously.

title.zh: 第 3 天赠送重置已发放

body.zh: Tibo 已确认，第 3 天赠送的一次可留存重置已发放至所有付费账户。可查看当前账号的可用重置次数；这次发放不等于立即重置正在使用的额度。
body.en: Tibo has confirmed that the Day 3 banked reset has landed across all paid accounts. Check your account’s available resets; this grant does not immediately reset the quota currently in use.
